title: Endurance (Interstellar)
intro: The Endurance is the fictional ring-shaped mothership of Interstellar (2014): a ring of twelve modules, four of them for the cockpit, laboratories and living space. It is usually flown with a Ranger shuttle docked. The film does not show a separate cockpit in detail, so the catalog takes its control module as Ranger-like, and this guide uses the Ranger's controls.
